aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of three per-profile means and three AppDomain-inclusive B/op values, not pooled independent samples, an application result or a net12 speedup.
limitations: Shared Hyper-V Windows VM; actual .NET Framework4.8.10008/x64 concurrent workstation GC; selected PE/PDB/source witnesses not a complete compiler/binary-source proof. B/op uses the actual AppDomain-inclusive managed operation/diagnostic counter boundary, not just MemoryStream; no native allocation measure. Small/adverse/noisy results retained; no fourth run. FullName plus bound native states disambiguates the two distinct1MiB enum values that the exporter Parameters/display strings both shorten to the same text.
statisticsChecked: All84 raw8-sample workloads, median overhead compensation, R7 upper-only filtering, retained values/counts, means/N-1 variance/SD/SE/R7 quantiles, reported CI bound arithmetic and raw GC tuple/denominator/midpoint-even allocation rounding. Student-t quantile and host clock calibration not independently reproduced.
